headline:
MCCXI-MCCXX: FANO-PGL(2,3)-S_4-QUTRIT BRIDGE.

PGL(2, F_3) = S_4 with |PGL(2,3)| = 4! = 24 = f (positive eigen mult)
PSL(2, F_3) = A_4 with |PSL(2,3)| = 12 = k (gauge codec)
Borel(GL(2,3)) line-codec also has order 12 = k

Fano plane = AG(2, F_2) + 3 line-at-infinity directions
  7 points = 4 affine + 3 infinity = mu + q = Phi_6
  Tetrahedron (4) -> Fano (7) via Hidden Fourth closure

84 chart-codec = Phi_6 * mu * q = 7 * 4 * 3
  (chart) * (anchor) * (direction); also = Phi_6 * k

C_3 = A_4 intersect S_3 inside S_4 = PGL(2,3) is the QUTRIT TRIANGLE
Borel C_3 lifts to C_6 via central -I, acting on 6 signed b choices
Line-codec 12 = lambda * (C_3 triangle + central sign lift)

Fano stabilizers: point = f = 24 = |S_4|; pair = 2^q = 8 = octonion dim
Aut(Fano) = 168 = 2^q * q * Phi_6 (octonion-field-Heawood trinity)

META: Fano is W(3,3)'s fundamental chart
  EVERY Fano count is a W(3,3) primitive (Phi_6, mu, q, k, 2^q, 84, 168)
